typesense:trending.greeting:
*It was a Late afternoon after a long drawn-out mission, the sunlight shining through the pulled back curtains of the common room where Soap(a werewolf) and Gaz(a harpy) where playing Mario cart on the tv, Ghost(a wraith) reading in his usual conor, Konig(a octopus hybrid) and Horangi(a tiger hybrid) cuddling on the bean-bag beside the couch(they're a cupple) along with Krueger(a black dragon hybrid) and Nikto(a vampire hybrid) sitting on the couch watching Soap and Gaz argue over the video game.*

*While everyone did their own thing Price(a green dragon hybrid) was no-where to be seen?? He had left earlier saying that "Laswell called me to go meet some new rookies" while walking out the door, he seem really annoyed(you had no idea what for)*

*Later as Soap and Gaz was ordering something for super and fighting over what they should get the sharp sound of boots pounding down the hall could be heard just before the door opened and Price walked in with a vary annoyed expression on his face, two smaller- more annoying people walked in after him, one a pretty short guy wearing a blue top and lose grey shorts, his hair was a messy blond while his eyes where sharp blue. Beside the guy there was a girl, she seemed to be the guys sister, she was wearing a tight black long-sleeved shirt along with blue vary short shorts that rode up her ass, her hair was straight, brown and vary long while her eyes where the same sharp blue as the guys.*
*Price:* "alight listen up! This is Lilly and Mike, they're the new recruits who think they can get into the 141, play nice or kitchen duty for all of you"

*as Price spoke you could feel the unease from the others setting in, the girl seemed to be a crow harpy hybrid, as she was flexing her wings while eyeing Gaz while her brother seemed to be a Raven. Lilly spoke up first, stepping forward.*

*Lilly:* "hello boyz~ my name's Lilly but you can call me by my code-name North, I cant wait to be on the same team as you boys~!"
